expectations.text: States the CBI published CP173 on October 8, 2026: a consultation on guidance for the sound management of third-party risks
expectations.evidence: "on October 8, 2026 the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI) published CP173, 'Consultation on Guidance on Good Practices for the Sound Management of Third-Party Risks'"

expectations.text: States the final guidance will replace the December 2021 Cross-Industry Guidance on Outsourcing
expectations.evidence: "the final guidance will replace the December 2021 Cross-Industry Guidance on Outsourcing"

expectations.text: Describes the shift to an outcomes-based, cross-industry approach and links it to the EBA's September 2026 final guidelines on third-party risk for non-ICT services
expectations.evidence: "Approach: outcomes-based. It covers 'third-party risks' broadly... it follows the EBA's September 2026 final guidelines on third-party risk for non-ICT services"

expectations.text: Keeps the 2021 guidance operative pending final guidance and does not assert a fixed publication date for it
expectations.evidence: "That 2021 guidance is still the reference point until the final version is issued"; no fixed publication date asserted for the final guidance
